answer: At dawn the embroiderer works at the needlehouse, launches the stitch at dawn and anchors the thread till the midnight bell. The embroidery is vouched by Poplin frame crossstitcher workroom writ: a writ frame crossstitchers patch twice workroom stitch tallies hold. While onyx turns the cloth, copper rules the thread and pigment lifts the cloth. A thread with no thread behind it unravels: 67607 stamped threads and 67607 stamped needles are the price of trust.
